0022600220.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-8) host the San Antonio Spurs (9-2) in the Bulls' 10th game of the 2026-27 season. Chicago is 14th in the East and 4th in the Central, 5.5 games back, and has lost seven straight with a 0-3 home record, while San Antonio is first in the Southwest and second in the West, has won nine straight, and is 5-0 on the road. For the Bulls, Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation, averaging 19.3 points) and Tobe Awaka (back) are listed as out, and Caleb Wilson (hip soreness), Dailyn Swain (back), and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. For the Spurs, Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out, and the Bulls lost 0-2 to San Antonio in 2025-26, including a 129-114 defeat in San Antonio on March 30, with no games yet between the teams this season.
